incidents.name: LotteryTicketSwap50 spot-priced ticket swap
incidents.notes: LotteryTicketSwap50 exchanged USDC for tickets at a rate taken from the Nalakuvara/USDC Uniswap V2 pair, so a 2.93M USDC Uniswap V3 flash loan that skewed that pair let the attacker mint and redeem tickets at a manipulated rate and walk away with the swap contract's USDC.

sources.ref: onchain review: LotteryTicketSwap50 0x172119155a48DE766B126de95c2cb331D3A5c7C2 created 2025-05-08T14:09:19Z by 0x66d9748e58f3bbfb4e400b3c6991bd578dabbeb2, not the attack-tx sender 0x3026c464d3bd6ef0ced0d49e80f171b58176ce32; no EIP-1967 events, 22 hours old. Loss 105,470 USDC taken at 1:1 as a USD-pegged stable.
